messages:
Lena V: Quick PSA — ran the onboarding sampleapp with default flags and hit a retry spin that made my laptop unusable. 429s, then retries piled up and memory grew. Repro attached.

Lena V: Repro steps: clone repo, npm run start (defaults), spawn 40 parallel workers that paginate and call .embed(). Observed runaway retry recursion + repeated auth refreshes.

Marco T: Can you paste the paginator + retry snippet? Sounds like retries are scheduled immediately and bypass the concurrency gate.

Lena V: snippet from sampleapp:
```go
func fetchPage(ctx context.Context, cur string) ([]Item, error) {
  slot := sem.Acquire()
  defer slot.Release()
  tok, _ := auth.GetToken(ctx) // naive: always refresh
  res, err := client.List(ctx, cur, tok)
  if err != nil && isRetryable(err) {
    // immediate retry
    return fetchPage(ctx, cur)
  }
  return res, err
}
```

Yasmin R: That recursive retry both re-enters the semaphore if it was released and also re-triggers token refresh. Two problems: (1) recursion can create many goroutines waiting, (2) token refresh stampede if token expiry lines up with bursts.

Marco T: Go SDK note: our Go examples still call GetToken per request. We should implement single-flight token refresh (sync.Once-like promise) and a RetryQueue that re-acquires the sem before retrying.

Lena V: Quick hack I ran: change recursion to loop + explicit acquire before each attempt, and make auth refresh acquire a refreshLock to serialize refreshes. Solved OOM on my run.

Yasmin R: Proposed changes:
- sampleapp: change retry recursion -> retry loop that acquires sem each attempt and uses exp-backoff + jitter
- Go SDK: add InflightRefresh (single-flight) and Config.MaxActiveSequences default 12
- CLI: add --protect-mode (alias --burst-safe) that sets safer defaults and prints a warning if concurrency > 64 without it
- Telemetry: emit sdk.client.refresh.inflight_max and sdk.client.retry.queue_length for hosted monitoring

Marco T: I'll open a Go SDK PR with the single-flight refresh + Config.MaxActiveSequences. Also add a small unit-test that simulates simultaneous expiry and asserts only one refresh function runs.

Lena V: I'll land the sampleapp change and add a small harness that runs 100 short workers and asserts memory stays bounded.

build-bot: Created task ONB-4712: "sampleapp: retry-loop + Go SDK single-flight refresh + protect-mode flag" assigned to Marco T, Lena V.

Yasmin R: Docs: add a short "protect your onboarding" note to quickstart explaining defaults and how to raise concurrency safely for Dedicated customers.

Marco T: Will aim for PR by tomorrow EOD.

Lena V: Thanks all, attaching flamegraph and the tiny repro script to ONB-4712.
